query:
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company,
  COUNT(m.id) as totalMeetings,
  MAX(CASE WHEN m.timeSlot = 10 THEN 'BOOKED' ELSE NULL END) as slot10,
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.companyName = 'Appcast' THEN 'YES' ELSE NULL END) as metAppcast
FROM delegateProfiles dp
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId AND m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE dp.attendeeId != '194295425320'
GROUP BY dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company
HAVING slot10 IS NULL AND metAppcast IS NULL AND totalMeetings < 8
ORDER BY dp.lastName;
